title: Automated Binary Analysis & Virtualization
subtitle: Scalable dynamic binary instrumentation, fast emulation engines, and multi-backend orchestration.
description: We architect high-performance program analysis frameworks that enable deep inspection, fuzzing, and vulnerability triage on stripped binary executables without source code.
highlights: FastDyn: QEMU-based hypervisor engine with adaptive execution slicing
xbin: Unified orchestration backend across Ghidra, angr, and Binary Ninja
Sub-microsecond dynamic instrumentation and memory tracking

tools.name: FastDyn
tools.description: Fast Dynamic Engine plugin for QEMU hypervisors.

title: Cyber-Physical & Robotics Protocol Security
subtitle: Semantic verification, differential protocol fuzzing, and safety enforcement for autonomous systems.
description: Autonomous robots, connected cars, and industrial IoT rely on real-time pub/sub middleware. We develop specialized fuzzers and invariant checkers to protect against state desynchronization and remote hijacking.
highlights: ddsfuzz: Differential protocol fuzzer for DDS and ROS2 middleware
Discovered 19 zero-day CVEs in automotive and industrial robotics stacks
Real-time runtime state-machine monitoring for physical safety

tools.name: ddsfuzz
tools.description: Differential fuzzer for DDS middleware in ROS2 & CPS.

title: Confidential Computing & Hardware Enclaves
subtitle: Architecting zero-trust trusted execution environments (TEEs) and memory safety boundaries.
description: Protecting data in use within multi-tenant clouds and edge accelerators. We design fine-grained isolation mechanisms, side-channel mitigations, and verifiable hardware enclave attestation.
highlights: Hardware-enforced compartmentalization for AMD SEV-SNP & Intel TDX
Sub-millisecond secure context switches without hypervisor trust
Microarchitectural side-channel defenses against transient execution attacks

title: Embedded Systems & Firmware Hardening
subtitle: Automated firmware rehosting, binary debloating, and memory compartmentalization for IoT.
description: Bare-metal microcontrollers and IoT platforms lack memory protection units (MPU) management. We create static/dynamic tooling to decompose monolithic blobs and retrofit fine-grained CFI.
highlights: Pieces: Monolithic firmware boundary extraction & rewriting
Slicer: LLVM bitcode slicing for 10x+ accelerated vulnerability discovery
Peripheral emulation for high-fidelity firmware rehosting

tools.name: Pieces
tools.description: Framework for analyzing, transforming, and hardening firmware binaries.

tools.name: slicer
tools.description: Accelerating fuzzing speed for memory bugs by slicing LLVM bitcode.
